question.text: In a first order reaction, the concentration of the reactant, decreases from 0.8 M to 0.4 M in 15 minutes. The time taken for the concentration to change from 0.1 M to 0.025 M is

solution.text: As the concentration of reactant decreases from 0.8 to 0.4 in 15 minutes, hence the $t_{1 / 2}$ is 15 minutes. To fall the concentration from 0.1 to 0.025 , we need two half lives, i.e., 30 minutes.
